description: A teal patterned floor-length court gown has a low square neckline, fitted opaque bodice, attached sleeves ending at the elbows and broad gold woven borders down the front and around the skirt. Small round decorative brooches with hanging tassels sit near the shoulders, and a narrow decorated belt fastens the waist. A cream wrap with teal-gold borders drapes loosely around both forearms, separate from the sleeves. Her hands rest visibly together in front, and two decorated closed boots appear below the skirt. Plain stone pillars and a dark wooden door form an unadorned background.
